style: Cute chibi four-panel manga (yonkoma) artwork in black and white only: round simple ink line, soft grey screentone, big heads and small bodies, expressive simple faces, no colour, monochrome.
suffix: Clean artwork only: no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no speech balloons, no captions, no sound-effect lettering, no signature, no logo, no panel border, no frame; the picture runs to the edges of the image.

items.prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain pure white background, full-body figures standing side by side in a neutral pose, front three-quarter view, evenly spaced with wide white gaps between them so each can be cut out separately, no shadows on the ground, no background scenery. Left: Mugi, a young woman who runs a cat cafe, chibi proportions, short bob hair with a small hair clip, cheerful face, long cafe apron over a striped shirt. Then three chibi cats sitting in a row with wide gaps: a fluffy white cat with a haughty look, a sleek black cat with big round eyes, and a calico cat with patches of black and grey screentone and a sleepy face.

Keep each character's face, hair, clothes, colours and proportions identical to the reference, but give them the new pose and expression described; do not copy the white background or the poses of the references. Morning, at the glass front door of a small cat cafe: Mugi unlocks the door with a key, smiling; inside behind the glass the three cats (white, black, calico) sit in a neat row staring at her. Keep the top third quiet and uncluttered (plain wall above the door) so speech balloons can be lettered there later. The only characters in the picture are Mugi and the three cats; no other people or animals.
